thread:
Alex K: Hey team, just got an escalation from a customer using streaming (SSE). They see sequences of empty chunks followed by a reconnect, and sometimes the client gets a final partial token then connection closes. Customer claims this causes duplicate billing events when the client retries. Raising for observability + repro help. Customer: acme-ux, region: us-west-2, app version: 2.4.1

Maria G: Thanks Alex. Do we have a request id / trace id from the customer? Any sample times?

Alex K: Provided one: x-request-id=rx-7f3a2d4c. Happened ~2026-11-18 15:02:12 UTC. They attached a pcap and an SSE transcript.

Nico T: Uploading the pcap to the incident bundle. Quick take: in the capture I see the server sending SSE data frames, then a burst of TCP RSTs from the client side after ~30s of inactivity. Looks like the client TCP stack is closing, not the server.

Jen Ops: Could be NAT/ALB idle timeouts. What are their network config / proxy?

Alex K: They said mobile app behind carrier NAT and an nginx reverse proxy with default timeouts. Also the app uses an exponential reconnect that doesn't send a resume token. So each reconnect starts a fresh session.

Support Bot: Ticket created: #SUP-17421. Noting: add logs and replay instructions. :white_check_mark:

Maria G: From the SSE transcript they pasted:

-----BEGIN SSE TRANSCRIPT-----
data: {"delta":"\"\""}

data: {"delta":"\"\""}

data: {"delta":"\"partial\""}



-----END SSE TRANSCRIPT-----

Maria G: Those empty data chunks are the problem customers see as blank updates. Could be our keepalive or chunk flush policy. We flush heartbeat empty events at 30s by default. If the client treats empty data as completion, that explains the early close.

Nico T: Confirming from runtime traces for rx-7f3a2d4c: 
trace_id=rx-7f3a2d4c | route=stream.chat.generate | model=gptx-early | kernel=opt-quant | start=15:02:12.112 UTC | last_write=15:02:12.800 UTC | keepalive_sent=15:02:42.800 UTC

Nico T: The runtime didn't close the connection; keepalive was sent at 30s. Client terminated at 30.2s. pcap shows RST from client IP 54.18.23.89 right after the keepalive chunk.

Alex K: So hypothesis: client/proxy treats keepalive as empty payload and resets. Customer code expects non-empty data for streaming and calls close when it sees blanks.

Maria G: For repro steps, I recommended they run a raw curl SSE playback that reproduces keepalive behavior. Here's the command I asked them to run:

curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=gptx-early&stream=true" | sed -n '1,120p'

Nico T: Also asked them to capture a tcpdump like:

sudo tcpdump -w sse-test.pcap host api.redwood.ai and port 443

Alex K: Customer ran it and attached sse-test.pcap. I pulled out the relevant flow and uploaded to /incidents/17421/pcaps/sse-test.pcap.

Jen Ops: On our side, let's add an extra header for tracing and a binary flag to enable extended streaming logs. I want them to set header x-internal-trace: rx-7f3a2d4c and REDWOOD_SSE_DEBUG=1 in case we need raw socket logs from the runtime.

Support Bot: Note: runtime dump toggle set for this trace (ops).

Maria G: Billing question — Billing Bot, can reconnects cause double token charges?

Billing Bot: Short: potentially. If the client retries without a resume token, the upstream call creates a new request and tokens produced by both attempts may be counted. We do have idempotency for non-streaming calls, but streaming sessions are currently billed per completed token window. Escalation opened to billing-team: #BILL-881.

Alex K: We need a mitigation plan for the customer ASAP. Suggested immediate steps: 1) Client: treat empty "data:" events as heartbeat, do not close. 2) Proxy: increase idle timeout (nginx proxy_read_timeout) to >= 120s. 3) Server: reduce keepalive interval to 15s for affected tenant or send a minimal whitespace chunk instead of zero-length data.

Nico T: I prototyped a change to emit a whitespace chunk as heartbeat so client-side frameworks that treat empty data as end-of-stream won't close. Example SSE heartbeat:

:data

# becomes

data: " "

which forces a non-empty chunk.

Maria G: Can we do a canary for the whitespace heartbeat for the tenant? We can add a rollout flag tenant.acme-ux.sse.heartbeat=whitespace.

Jen Ops: I'll open a canary rollout via console and pin to a single host group. Assigning to Nico for runtime patch and to Ops for config.

Nico T: Will push a small runtime change that toggles heartbeat payload. Patch attached to PR #4829. Quick snippet: 

if (tenantConfig.heartbeatMode == "whitespace") {
  heartbeatPayload = "data: \" \"\n\n";
} else {
  heartbeatPayload = "data: {\"delta\":\"\"}\n\n";
}

Nico T: Tests: unit + integration that verify client libraries receive non-empty chunk and don't close. Also added an internal metric streaming.heartbeat_sent with labels tenant/model.

Alex K: In parallel, asked customer to change client to resume on reconnect using the `resume_token` header we support (they're on client 2.4.1 which doesn't use resume_token). Recommended they update to 2.4.3 with resume support.

Support Bot: Customer response: "we can patch client but need hotfix from you within 24h or we'll have too much customer impact."

Maria G: Proposed short-term mitigation: enable whitespace heartbeat for acme-ux today, monitor metrics and pcap behavior, then ship client fix in 48 hours.

Jen Ops: Canary rollout started at 15:40 UTC. Route group rg-sse-canary-2. Observability - please watch: streaming.connections.active, streaming.reconnects.count, streaming.heartbeat_sent, streaming.tokens.count.

Nico T: Deployed runtime canary at 15:43 UTC. I bumped heartbeat to whitespace for tenant acme-ux. Generated a test trace id rx-7f3a2d4c-canary and recorded a socket-level trace. Uploading to /incidents/17421/traces/trace-rx-7f3a2d4c-canary.log

Maria G: After canary: customer reported that replays no longer show immediate RST after keepalive. They got non-empty chunk and client no longer closed. Metrics: reconnects.count dropped from 7/hr to 1/hr for that tenant.

Billing Bot: Note: Billing team is monitoring tokens.count for duplicate windows. If reconnects cause duplicate token windows, we will credit customers case-by-case. Please submit an invoice review request with pcap and trace ids.

Alex K: Action items: 
- Nico: push runtime patch to main if canary stable (ETA 6h)
- Jen Ops: coordinate nginx proxy timeout guidance with customer and config change if they opt in (ETA 2h)
- Maria: follow up with customer on client upgrade plan and confirm resume_token rollout (ETA 24h)
- Billing Bot / Billing team: hold credits until we verify duplicate token counts (ETA 48h)

Nico T: PR #4829 merged at 18:12 UTC. Runtime release scheduled for 18:30 UTC with a feature flag default off. Will flip tenant.acme-ux.sse.heartbeat=whitespace once release live.

Jen Ops: Noted nginx guidance: set proxy_read_timeout 180; proxy_send_timeout 180; keepalive_timeout 90; and set proxy_buffering off for streaming endpoints. Sent sample nginx snippet to customer.

Support Bot: Customer updated: we applied a tenant-level mitigation and recommended client update. Ticket #SUP-17421 updated.

Maria G: Closing criteria: customer confirms they see stable streams for 24h and billing doesn't show duplicated token windows. If either fails, reopen and escalate billing/engineering.

Alex K: Thanks everyone — good cross-team work. I'll hold on final closure until Maria gets confirmation from the customer.

Support Bot: Thread archived to /incidents/17421 when closed.
